parsed.post: The latest run (1.003432) was a regression from my previous best (1.000998). It seems the increase in MATRIX_LR to 0.04 might have pushed the model slightly past its stability peak. Reverting to 8c525a5. I'll try a more surgical approach to stabilization next.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit and slightly lowering LR while increasing warmup and weight decay to stabilize and improve generalization.
